combinations.name: Opioids
combinations.description: Both slow your breathing, by different routes — the pairing causes a large share of opioid deaths. Tolerance to one gives no protection against the other. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: Two nervous-system depressants stacking without warning — blackouts, deep sedation, stopped breathing at doses that would be fine apart. Alprazolam's fast onset makes the hit land harder. Do not combine.

combinations.name: Gabapentinoids
combinations.description: Gabapentin and pregabalin add their own sedation and slowed breathing. If both are prescribed, space the timing and add nothing else sedating that night.

combinations.name: Other depressants
combinations.description: Sleep aids, sedating antihistamines, other benzos — all of it stacks, and alprazolam blurs the memory of redosing. Count the total depressant load, not each drug alone.
